title: TrumpFile Timeline Alleges Miss Teen USA Rehearsal Conduct; Claims Uncorroborated
description_short: TrumpFile attributes allegations about 1997 Miss Teen USA rehearsals to its timeline, unnamed contestants and Noel Casler; corroboration is absent.
description_medium: A TrumpFile.org timeline dated August 20, 1997 says Ivanka Trump co-hosted Miss Teen USA and alleges Donald Trump asked her for a lap dance during rehearsals. It asserts she was 15 and attributes dressing-room claims to unnamed contestants and other statements to Noel Casler. The page provides no direct Casler statement, named contestant testimony, contemporaneous pageant record, or response. The conduct, age, and chronology therefore remain uncorroborated allegations, not established facts.

facts_reported_in_packet_review.fact: The page heading is dated August 20, 1997 and says Ivanka Trump co-hosted Miss Teen USA.
facts_reported_in_packet_review.basis: The packet records an Evidence-resolution review dated 2026-10-03 after the page was read at HTTP 200; this run could not re-read it.

facts_reported_in_packet_review.fact: The page alleges Donald Trump asked Ivanka for a lap dance during rehearsals “the day of or in the days before” and asserts she was 15.
facts_reported_in_packet_review.basis: The packet’s 2026-10-03 review reports these as claims made by the page, not independently established facts.

facts_reported_in_packet_review.fact: The page attributes dressing-room claims to unnamed contestants and other claims to Noel Casler, and references a 2005 interview.
facts_reported_in_packet_review.basis: The packet’s 2026-10-03 review reports these attributions and reference; it supplies no direct Casler statement or contestant testimony.

limitations: The packet review says the page supplied no direct Casler statement, named contestant testimony, contemporaneous pageant record, or response from the people named; its photo was from another event.

The direct URL returned HTTP 403 in the single focused retrieval attempt on 2026-10-04, so the prior packet review is the available account of page contents. The URL supports what the timeline reportedly alleges, not independent proof that the alleged conduct occurred.
